keySentence: I think love makes us real.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: We learned many stories. Love was in every one. Love makes us real. I think love makes us real.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: We have read so many wonderful stories this year. Every story taught us about love, courage, and kindness. I think love makes us real, just like the velveteen rabbit. When we love someone truly, amazing things can happen. The boy's love turned a simple toy into a living rabbit. Let us carry this lesson with us forever in our hearts.
facts.Word cards: real = 진짜의 / love = 사랑 / happen = 일어나다 / magic = 마법
